author: Will_29
body:
Yeah, this is not a complex event. Kill the murks (regular mobs and raid boss) for nurtured nature, use it to get rewards. The main attraction are the followers you can buy, these are very good.

You get more nurtured nature if you can keep the animal NPCs alive through the raid.

author: Independent-Chef8985
body: Pretty much grind event mobs for event currency for event pets, summons and other stuff in the event store
